description: Least-privilege capability for the main window. Every entry is a call the renderer actually makes; see docs/adr/0002-production-csp-and-webview-capabilities.md before adding one. Plaintext keyring export (keyring-store), opener, and every filesystem power are deliberately absent: passwords go through Rust commands, no renderer code opens URLs or reads/writes files, and each file flow consumes a backend-issued File Grant instead of a renderer-supplied path.
